faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kerala University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Controller of Examinations and Registrar posts at Kerala University is 03 October 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Controller of Examinations and Registrar posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a first or second class Master's Degree or an equivalent qualification to be eligible for both the Controller of Examinations and Registrar positions at Kerala University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for these posts is 40 years, and the maximum age limit is 56 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be appointed at Academic Level 14, which is a competitive salary structure for academic and administrative roles in universities.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy each for the post of Controller of Examinations and Registrar, making a total of two vacancies announced by Kerala University for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Kerala University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is ₹5000. This fee needs to be paid online as part of the application process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application process for Kerala University Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official recruitment portal of Kerala University to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The recruitment for Controller of Examinations and Registrar posts at Kerala University is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF for comprehensive information on the selection methodology.
